import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.cluster import SpectralClustering
from sklearn.metrics.pairwise import cosine_similarity

MAX_DRIVERS = 4

def design(feats):
    # Identify highly associated features using t-statistics
    t_stats = [abs(stats.ttest_ind(feats.x[feats.y==1, feats.column(fid)], 
                                   feats.x[feats.y==0, feats.column(fid)])[0]) 
               for fid in feats.ids]
    
    # Select top features by t-statistic
    top_indices = np.argsort(t_stats)[::-1][:20]
    top_ids = [feats.ids[i] for i in top_indices]
    
    # Remove near-duplicates based on correlation
    keep_ids = []
    for fid in top_ids:
        is_duplicate = False
        for kept in keep_ids:
            if abs(np.corrcoef(feats.x[:, feats.column(fid)], 
                               feats.x[:, feats.column(kept)])[0,1]) > 0.6:
                is_duplicate = True
                break
        if not is_duplicate:
            keep_ids.append(fid)
    
    # If no strong mechanism, return empty design
    if len(keep_ids) < 2:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Formulate potential mechanism: cluster features
    X = feats.x[:, [feats.column(fid) for fid in keep_ids]]
    clustering = SpectralClustering(n_clusters=1, affinity='precomputed', 
                                    random_state=0)
    similarity = cosine_similarity(X)
    clusters = clustering.fit_predict(1 - similarity)  # Convert to distance
    
    # Select features in the same cluster as the strongest
    best_feature_idx = np.argmax(t_stats)
    best_cluster = clusters[best_feature_idx]
    selected_features = [keep_ids[i] for i in range(len(keep_ids)) 
                         if clusters[i] == best_cluster]
    
    # Compute weighted loading score
    loadings = {}
    for fid in selected_features:
        idx = feats.column(fid)
        # Weight by effect size (t-statistic)
        t_stat = stats.ttest_ind(feats.x[feats.y==1, idx], 
                                feats.x[feats.y==0, idx])[0]
        loadings[fid] = abs(t_stat)
    
    # Normalize loadings
    total_weight = sum(loadings.values())
    if total_weight > 0:
        loadings = {fid: w/total_weight for fid, w in loadings.items()}
    
    # Return mechanism design
    return Design(
        drivers=tuple(selected_features[:MAX_DRIVERS]),
        columns=tuple(selected_features),
        products=(),
        loadings=loadings
    )
